plan.request: Reduce measured deviation dots through shared physical model changes; no pointwise offsets or altered plotting metric
plan.hypothesis: The homogeneous sphere inertia and radial contact lever assumptions bias spin and translation for faceted rocks. Test one shared effective inertia, then shared dimensionless oblique contact geometry, using full normal/tangent mobility and both restitution coefficients.
models: baseline sphere en et mu, alpha0.4
shared inertia en et mu alpha
shared effective facet en et mu alpha s with contact lever r/R=(s,-1)
plan.physics: Exact shared-point Jacobian, positive inertia, Coulomb cone, full contact normal/tangent target coupling, actual energy check; zero incoming spin and unknown experimental facet geometry remain assumptions.
plan.validation: Fit only on each training split. Evaluate four leave-one-plate-angle groups and three leave-one-release-height groups. The prior4.5m split is an out-of-fit development comparison, not a new blind test. These data have already informed development; no independent validation claim.
plan.acceptance: Both pooled group-CV errors must improve vs refitted frozen-law baseline; report per-component RMSE, mapping errors, improved-point counts and all regressions. No production adoption from an effective-geometry fit without measured-shape validation.
plan.optimizer: Fixed multistarts selected by training residual only; joint residual outgoing normal/tangent and R*omega divided by incoming speed. Invalid/injective predictions rejected.
plan.mapping: Keep existing ell=radius, axes and observed signatures unchanged; evaluate all predictions at identical recorded incoming states.
plan.rubber: Separately cross-validate one inertia per ball material across four surfaces. This cannot independently validate friction or remove the previously established incompatibility of one inertia with all measured spin intervals.
